decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - Loss of original fabric and features shall be kept to the minimum required to enable the works to be completed.
Condition : 5 - New work shall be in accordance with the recommendations of Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.
description: Adding a new internal wall to create sliding doors between the double reception room and moving the entrance door to the second reception room over by 200mm to accomodate the new wall and sliding doors.
